name: Mindwtr
author: Sebastian
description: Mindwtr GTD tasks from a self-hosted Mindwtr Cloud server in the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Focus, Inbox, Next, Waiting and Someday buckets from your Mindwtr Cloud server, with quick capture and mark-done.

schema.label: Badge
schema.description: Which bucket the number next to the icon counts.

schema.label: Show count
schema.description: Show the bucket count as a badge on the bar icon.

schema.label: Quick capture
schema.description: Show the capture field in the panel. Adds to the Inbox through POST /v1/tasks.

schema.label: Row checkbox
schema.description: Show a checkbox on each row; clicking it or pressing d marks the task done. Clicking the row opens its details.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the bar reloads tasks from the server.
